notes: Mechanical limits of the SERVO-DRIVE variants use the SAME lift mechanism sets and weight/power-factor ranges as the standard AVENTOS top sheets; no SERVO-DRIVE-specific weight change is printed.
Main difference for planning: mechanism width 30 -> 66 mm (HK top 67 mm) and HK top internal depth 187 -> 235 mm (261 with visible wall hanging bracket).
HK top and HF top sheets read are Australian editions (-AA); HL top and HS top are global EN 04.26 editions; codes could differ per market.
Opening: touch/press front. Closing: SERVO-DRIVE switch (wireless 2.4 GHz, CR2032) or manual; no 'auto-close' timer for AVENTOS is documented (only flex has hold-open time).
Ø10 cable hole axes (X from side panel, Y from top underside) read from HF top detail drawing HFT p13 (image) and applied to HL/HS/HK by analogy: verify before use as machine data.
